Machine Learning Engineer - Inference Platform

About us
Fabrikam Robotics builds perception software for warehouse robots. We are a remote-friendly team of 40 engineers.

What you'll do
- Deploy ML inference services that serve models at low latency.
- Collaborate with data scientists to productionize models.
- Monitor model performance and drift in production.

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional experience with Python.
- Experience deploying ML inference services in production.
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes for container orchestration.
- Experience with AWS cloud services.
- Strong SQL skills.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and unit testing.

Nice to have
- Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure as code tools.
- Familiarity with ONNX Runtime or TensorRT.
- Experience mentoring engineers.

Benefits
- Health insurance, learning budget and flexible hours.
